title: Open subschemes have derived localizations in the ambient Hom universe
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and U an open subscheme. If the category of O_X-modules has a chosen derived localization whose morphisms live in universe w [def-pc-derived-category], then the category of O_U-modules admits a derived localization with morphisms in the same universe w. There is no quasi-compactness or quasi-coherence assumption.

source.place: faithful_rightDerivedFunctor, full_rightDerivedFunctor; locallySmall_of_faithful; hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall; open counit from Stacks Tag 08FE

proof.text: Put the standard localization on modules on U. Exact open restriction is left adjoint to module direct image, whose counit is invertible, so direct image is fully faithful and preserves K-injective complexes. Apply the proved upstream full_rightDerivedFunctor and faithful_rightDerivedFunctor instances to this direct image.

The derived direct image is faithful into the fixed D(X), with morphisms in universe w. Mathlib locallySmall_of_faithful shows that standard D(U) is locally w-small. Apply hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall to the quasi-isomorphism localization Q of cochain complexes, obtaining a localization with Hom types in w.

proof_origin.document: Source library FullyFaithful.lean and Mathlib LocallySmall.lean
proof_origin.place: Specialize fully faithful right derived direct image to an open and shrink the standard localization.

mathlib_searches.query: A localization has small morphism types if a faithful functor embeds it in a locally small category
